sections.title: King Arphaxad, as it is written, surrounded by the multitude.

verses.text: In the great city of Nineveh, during the reign of the king of Assyria, who was called Arphaxad in the second year of the reign, he ruled over Media and Bitnah.

He constructed a wall around Bitnah, and the breadth of its foundation on the side of the city was thirty cubits; the length of the space in front of the city was sixty cubits. He made the height of the wall seven cubits, and the thickness was fifty cubits.
As he passed by every hundred cubits, he established the house of the watchman; its foundation from one wall to the other was sixty cubits.
The mighty, powerful, and skilled army that would enter therein, he made the height of its gates seven cubits, and their breadth he made forty cubits.
In those days, Arphaxad, the king, fought in a broad plain; that plain is in the region of Ragau.

And all the people who dwelt in the mountains came forth and received him; in Ephrath and in Tigris, in Hidespon, and in the region of the king of Elimelech, all who dwelt in the land of the Chaldeans gathered together in great numbers.
And the king of the Persians, Nabuchadnezzar, sent to all who dwelt in the region of Persia, in Cilicia, in Damascus, and in Lebanon, to all who dwelt by the river Dar.
In Carmel and in Gilead, in Galilee, and in the broad plain of the wilderness, to all the people who dwelt there.
To all the people who dwelt in Samaria and in its region, from the river Jordan to Jerusalem and to Bileath, to Kilos and to Qades, to the river of Egypt, to Taphnas and Ramis, to the land of Gisem.
To all who dwelt in Taneos and in Menifeos, even unto Egypt, he sent to all until the border of Ethiopia.

All who dwell upon the earth have refused the command of King Nabuchadnezzar, and they have not gone to battle against him. They feared him not, for they have become as one man before him. And the messengers returned empty, having turned back from before them.

And Nabuchadnezzar was exceedingly angry upon that land; he commanded the destruction of all the regions of Kilikia and Demasquin, and all the provinces of Syria, and he commanded the destruction of all who dwell in the land of Moab, and the children of Ammon, and all who dwell in Judah, even to those who dwell in Egypt, to be utterly destroyed by the sword, as it is said concerning his throne and his kingdom.

sections.title: King Arphaxad was victorious as it was.

verses.text: And in the year of the thirty-seventh, King Arphaxad went forth with all his army; and he smote the children of Arphaxad, and all his horsemen and chariots he took away.
And he laid waste all the nations, and even unto the land of Batan, he went forth and laid waste their mountains; and he utterly destroyed all the nations.
And Arphaxad took his army and went forth into battle; and he completely destroyed them.
And he returned; and many men who were exceedingly valiant with him also returned; and there he remained, pondering and meditating for a hundred and twenty days.

sections.title: A war that was waged against the peoples dwelling in the west.

verses.text: In the year of the tenth month, on the first month, on the seventh day, as it was spoken, let all the land be destroyed; and the counsel of the king of Assyria, Nabuchadnezzar, was established in the palace.
He summoned all the governors and the rulers, and he revealed the secret of his counsel to them; and he spoke of all the evil that was in his land.
To destroy all the people who did not accept the command that was spoken in the decree, he commanded them to be put to death.
After this, when he commanded, the king of Assyria, Nabuchadnezzar, called for Holophernes, who was under him, and he said to him:

"Thus says the lord of all the land, the king of the Assyrians: Behold, one hundred twenty thousand men of valor who have trusted in their strength, and one hundred twenty thousand horsemen, together with their horses, shall go forth before you."
"For the matter I have spoken to you, do not be dismayed, for you shall go forth to the land that lies to the west."

"I will go forth against them, and I will trample the earth under my feet with my army, and I will burn their money; I will take their provisions and their water, and you shall speak to them the command that I have given you."
Their carcasses shall be cast into the river and into the sea; and the river shall return to them their heads.
"I will consume their harvest until the very edge of the earth."
"But you, go forth and take all their territories; if they return to you, you shall keep them until the day I judge them."
ዐመፀኞችን ታጠፋቸው ዘንድ፤ በሄድህበትም ሁሉ ትዘርፋቸው ዘንድ ዐይንህ አትራራላቸው።
እኔ ሕያው ነኝና እንደ ተናገርሁም ይኽን በእጄ አደርግ ዘንድ መንግሥቴ ጽኑዕ ነውና።
እንዳዘዝሁህ አድርግ እንጂ አንተም ከእኔ ከጌታህ ቃል አንዲት ስንኳ የምትተወው አይኑር፤ ይህንም ፈጥነህ አድርግ።”

sections.title: The Book of Holophonis

verses.text: And Holofernes called all the mighty men, and the captains, and the soldiers of the army of Assyria before his lord.
And the lord commanded, and there were chosen a hundred twenty thousand footmen, and twelve thousand horsemen.
They were to go forth and execute his command.
And there were exceedingly many camels and sheep, and all manner of food that could be had, and cattle and goats, and also many provisions for the journey.
And he gave to many people and to all the army a great amount of silver and gold from the house of the king.
And he went forth with all his army; and with horses and chariots, and with the chosen footmen, he went to possess all the land that was on the side of the west.
And many people went forth with them, and their number was as the locusts and as the sand of the sea; and they were without number.
And they departed from Nineveh, and journeyed for three days in the plain of Bectileth; and they encamped by the mountain that is on the side of the west, near Bectileth.
And thereafter Holofernes took all his army, and the horsemen and footmen, and the chariots, and went to the mountainous country.
And he took with him the children of Rhesus and the children of the Ishmaelites that dwelt in the plain that is on the left side of Eleon.
And he departed from Ephrat, and went unto Mespeh; and he smote all the great cities that were upon the forty rivers until he reached the sea.
He took the region of Qilqiya, and he destroyed all his enemies; and he went as far as the region of Azev, even unto the region of Yafeth on the west.
And he took all the children of Midian; and he plundered their possessions; and he laid waste their houses.

In the time of the wheat harvest, he laid waste all that was in the valley of Damasco; and he commanded that their oxen and their goodly cattle be driven away; and he destroyed their pastures; and he laid waste their children and smote all their warriors with the sword.

And from among them arose fear and terror, and they fell upon the shores of the sea, in Tyre and Sidon, and upon the inhabitants of Akin and Seir, and upon the people that dwell in Yamnia. And the inhabitants of Askelon and Azaton, when they heard of his coming, were seized with fear and fled.

sections.title: Messengers of Peace

verses.text: እንዲህም ብለው የሰላም መልእክተኞችን ወደ እርሱ ላኩ።
“እነሆ፥ እኛ የገናናው ንጉሥ የናቡከደነፆር ባሮች በፊትህ እንኖራለን። በፊትህም እንደ ወደድህ አድርገን።
እነሆ፥ ከተሞቻችንና አንባዎቻችንም ሁሉ፥ እርሻችንም ሁሉ፥ መንጋዎቻችንም፥ የመሰማሪያችን ቦታዎች ሁሉ፥ በጎቻችንም በፊትህ ያንተ ናቸው፤ እንደ ወደድህም አድርግ።
እነሆ ታላላቆች ከተሞቻችን በእነርሱ የሚኖሩ ሰዎች ባሮችህ ናቸው፤ መጥተህም እንደ ወደድህ አድርግ።”
እነዚያም ሰዎች ወደ ሆሎፎርኒስ ደርሰው ይህን ነገር ነገሩት።
እርሱም ወደ መንደራቸው ወረደ፤ ሠራዊቱም ከእርሱ ጋር ወረዱ ከፍ ከፍ ያሉ አንባዎችንም አስጠበቀ፥ ከእነርሱም የሚረዱትን የተመረጡ ሰዎችን ወሰደ።
ወገኖቻቸው ሁሉና እነርሱም አክሊል ደፍተው እየዘፈኑ፥ በገና እየደረደሩና ከበሮ እየመቱ ተቀበሉት።
እርሱ ግን አውራጃቸውን ሁሉ አጠፋ፤ ጣዖቶቻቸውንም ሰበረ፤ አሕዛብም ሁሉ ናቡከደነፆርን ብቻ እንዲያመልኩት፥ ቋንቋዎችና ነገዶች ሁሉ አምላክ እንዲሉት እርሱ የሰውን ሁሉ ጣዖት ያጠፋ ዘንድ ታዝዞ ነበር።
በትልቁ በይሁዳ ተራራ አንፃር የገባኢያ ዕጣ ወደሚሆን ወደ ኤስድራሎንም መጣ።
በሴቅቶን ከተማና በጌባን ሜዳ መካከልም ሰፈረ፤ ለሠራዊቱም ስንቅ ያዘጋጅ ዘንድ በዚያ አንድ ወር ተቀመጠ።

sections.title: The preparation that the Jews made to defend themselves.

verses.text: And it came to pass that the children of Israel who dwelt in Judah heard all that Holophernes had done to the cities of the Amorites, and how he had destroyed all their borders, and they were afraid for themselves.
And they arose from their places, and they were filled with fear concerning Jerusalem and concerning their God, the Lord of hosts, and they hastened to gather together.

And all the chosen tribes of Judah were gathered together, and they were assembled after they had returned from the captivity, and they sanctified themselves and the holy vessels, and they cleansed the temple after it had been defiled.

Therefore they sent messengers to the regions of Samaria and to the cities of the plain, and to Bethoron and to Belmain, and to Jericho and to Choba, and to Esora and to Salem, and to all the places around.
They took hold of the heights of their mountains. And the villages in which they dwelt were fortified. And they gathered themselves together beforehand, and they prepared for war.

And in those days, there was a chief of the priests in Jerusalem, Joakim, who wrote concerning those who dwelt in the wilderness near Dothaim, and concerning those who dwelt in Bethomestha and in Bethel.

And in that day, the entrance to Judah was a matter of great concern, for the entrance was only a passage for two men; but because it was a watch, he wrote, "Guard the entrance of the valleys, lest those who go out be harmed."

sections.title: The Prayer of Israel

verses.text: የእስራኤልም ልጆች ታላቁ ካህን ኢዮአቄምና በኢየሩሳሌም የሚኖሩ የእስራኤል ወገኖች አለቆች ሁሉ እንዳዘዙአቸው አደረጉ።
የእስራኤልም ልጆች ከፍ ባለ ቃል ወደ እግዚአብሔር ጮኹ፤ ሰውነታቸውንም በጽኑ ኀዘን አሳዘኑ።
እነርሱም ሚስቶቻቸውና ልጆቻቸው፥ ከብቶቻቸውም፥ ምንደኛውና ስደተኛው ሁሉ፥ በዋጋም የተገዛው ሁሉ ማቅ ለብሰው አለቀሱ።
የእስራኤልም ወገኖች ሁሉ ሚስቶቻቸውና በኢየሩሳሌም የሚኖሩ ልጆቻቸውም በቤተ መቅደስ ደጃፍ ወደቁ፤ በራሳቸውም ትቢያ ነሰነሱ፤ በእግዚአብሔርም ፊት ማቃቸውን አነጠፉ፤ መሠዊያውንም ማቅ አለበሱ።
ልጆቻቸውን እንዳይነጠቁ፥ ሚስቶቻቸውን እንዳይማረኩ፥ የርስታቸው ከተሞችም እንዳይጠፉ፥ መቅደሳቸውንም እንዳያረክሱ፥ ለአሕዛብም መዘበቻ እንዳያደርጉት ወደ እስራኤል አምላክ በአንድነት ፈጽመው ጮኹ።
እግዚአብሔርም መከራቸውን አይቶ ልመናቸውን ሰማ፤ ሕዝቡም በኢየሩሳሌምና በይሁዳ ሁሉን በሚችል በእግዚአብሔር መቅደስ ፊት ብዙ ቀን ጾሙ።
በእግዚአብሔር ፊት የሚቆሙ ታላቁ ካህን ኢዮአቄምና ካህናቱ፥ የእግዚአብሔርንም ሥራ የሚሠሩ ሰዎች በወገባቸው ማቅ ታጠቁ፤ የዘወትሩን መሥዋዕት፥ የስእለቱንና ሕዝቡ በፈቃድ የሚያቀርቡትን መሥዋዕት አገቡ።
በራሳቸውም ዐመድ ነሰነሱ፤ በፍጹም ኀይላቸውም ወደ እግዚአብሔር ጮኹ፤ “የእስራኤልንም ወገን በምሕረት ተመልከት” አሉ።

sections.title: And Holofornis was called to make a gathering over Israel.

verses.text: "The children of Israel prepared for battle; they fortified their gates and secured their strongholds; they made their way through the paths." Thus they spoke to the commander of the Assyrian army, Holophernes.
And he was greatly enraged; he called upon the leaders of Moab and the princes of Ammon, and also summoned the lords who were around the sea.

And he said to them, "O children of Canaan! Tell me, what are these tribes that dwell in the mountains? And those that dwell in the cities, what are their many armies? How great is their strength? Who is the king that speaks against them? Or their prince? Or who is their commander?"
"How is it that they have not come to me, to join with all the people who dwell in the west?"

sections.title: The discourse of Achor.

verses.text: The children of Ammon spoke thus, saying, “Hear this word from me, your servant; for a lie shall not proceed from me, but concerning these nations, and because they dwell near you, I will declare the truth unto you.”
These nations came from Kelaudewon.
In the land of Kelaudewon, they did not worship the idols of their fathers, but rather they dwelt in Mespehtomiah.
And they forsook the way of their kindred, and turned away from their idols, and they cried unto the God of heaven, unto the Lord, and they dwelt in Mespehtomiah for a long time.

Their Creator commanded them to depart from the land whither they were driven, and to go unto Canaan; and there they dwelt for many years, and they gathered silver and gold, and they multiplied greatly.
There was a famine in all the land of Canaan, and they went down to Egypt; and there they dwelt, and there they were filled; and there their number was not counted.
And the king of Egypt rose up against them; he oppressed them, and he afflicted them with burdens; he made their lives bitter with hard service, and he set taskmasters over them.
And they cried unto their God; and He, the healer, destroyed all the land of Egypt with a plague, and the Egyptians fled from before them.
And the Lord caused the sea of Eritrea to dry up before them.
And they went to the mountain of Sinai and to Kadesh Barnea; and they brought forth all that dwelt in the wilderness.
And they dwelt in the land of the Amorites; and they utterly destroyed all the people of Heshbon with their might, and they took possession of the land of the mountainous region.
And they cast out all the inhabitants of Canaan, the Perizzites, the Jebusites, the Shechemites, and all the Girgashites from before them; and they dwelt there many years.
"In the presence of their Creator, when they were not in rebellion, all good things were theirs; for the Lord God who removes iniquity was with them."

But when they forsook the commandments that He had given them, they were utterly destroyed by many armies; and they were scattered unto a foreign land; their Creator's dwelling place, the house of the sanctuary, was forsaken; it became a desolate wilderness; and their enemies took their cities.

Yet today they returned to their Creator; and from the land where they had been scattered, they were gathered; they dwelt in Jerusalem, where the house of the sanctuary is; for it is a desolate wilderness, and they dwelt upon the mountain.

Even now, my Lord, these nations are as if they are in iniquity; and their Creator is as if He is in rebellion against them; this is their calamity, and let us once again be vigilant; thereafter we shall rise up and defend them.
But if these nations are without iniquity, my Lord shall deliver them; behold, their Lord shall save them; or their God shall stand for them; and we shall be in freedom throughout all their land."

After this, when Achior spoke these words, all the nations that were encamped around them began to murmur; the men of Holophernes, and all those who dwelt by the sea and in Moab said, "Let us go against Achior."
"For with a strong warrior, we shall not fear the weakness and strength of the nations that we are to fight against, the children of Israel."
Therefore, our Lord Holophernes said, "Indeed, they shall be food for all your enemies."

sections.title: Achor was given as a place of trouble for Israel.

verses.text: And after this, when those men who were around the camp were silent, the commander of the Assyrian army, Holophernes, spoke in the presence of the Philistines and the children of Moab, saying:

"O you who dwell in Ephraim, what are you doing? Today you speak prophecies to us, for the Lord has delivered you; do not deceive the children of Israel, for who are you? Without Nabuchadnezzar, who is the Lord?"

He has sent forth the mighty to utterly destroy them from the face of the earth; their God will not spare them; and we, the servants of Nabuchadnezzar, shall utterly destroy them as one man; for we shall prevail against them, and their horses shall not be able to withstand our might.

Their mountains shall be soaked with their blood; their children shall be made desolate; for the Lord of all the earth has said, "I will destroy the servants of Nabuchadnezzar," and let my word not be false; they shall perish from this world, but they shall not stand before us.

"Today, because of your sin, you have spoken this, O commander of the Ammonites; but I shall protect Israel, who have come out from the land of Egypt, until I have destroyed them; from this day forth, you shall no longer see my face."
At that time, the warriors of the children of Ammon and their allies shall fall upon you; you shall be overwhelmed with their multitude.
And when I return, the servants shall take you to their master; and if you are captured, you shall dwell in a city of their own.
Until I have destroyed them, they shall not harm you.
As you wish in your heart, so shall it be; your face shall not be ashamed; for I have spoken, and my word shall not fall to the ground."
And Holophernes commanded that the servants who were in his tent should take the provisions and bring them to his camp, that he might give them to the children of Israel.

And they took their possessions and went outside the camp into the wilderness; and from the wilderness they journeyed to the mountainous land; and thereafter they reached the springs that are beneath Bethel.

And when the people of that land saw them, they took their weapons and went up from the city to the top of the mountain. And all those who bore arms guarded the entrance; and they set a watch over them.
They broke the foot of Acyor; and they laid waste beneath the mountain; and there they set a watch beneath the mountain; and they turned back to their Lord.
And the children of Israel turned back from their mourning and went to him; and they pressed on and went to Bethel.

And in those days the leaders of their cities were gathered, among them were the sons of Neged, the son of Simeon, and the son of Ozias, and the son of Gotonias, and the son of Melchial, and they set them in order.

And they called all the leaders who were in their cities; and their women and their maidservants all ran to their tents; and they gathered Acyor in the midst of them; and Ozias inquired of all that was done.

As they spoke among themselves like the leaders of the army of Assyria, so did they speak; and Holophernes also spoke in pride against the children of Israel, as he had spoken, and he declared all the matters of Holophernes.
And all the people fell down upon their faces and worshiped the Lord; and thus they cried out:
“O Lord God of heaven, behold their pride; and do not turn away from the affliction of our people; and on this day look upon your sanctuary.”
And they rejoiced over Acyor; and they completed their worship.

And Ozias, having gathered them together, went into his house; and he made a feast for his brethren, and he prayed unto the God of Israel that they might be strengthened in that night to partake of the feast.

sections.title: The Honor of Bethel

verses.text: And it came to pass that Holophernes went up to Bethulia, and he took with him the entrance of the valley of the children of Israel, and he gathered together all the men of war that were with him, and all the captains of the armies.

And in that day, there came down against them a mighty host of valiant men, and those who were with them were many; and there were of the footmen a hundred seventy thousand, and of the horsemen twelve thousand.

And they encamped by Bethulia, near the fountain that is in the valley of the water, and they remained there until the time of the evening, and they descended from Bethulia even unto the plain of Kiyamos.

And the children of Israel were exceedingly afraid at that time; and they said one to another, “These men will consume the whole earth; whether it be mountain or valley, there is none that can withstand their multitude.”
And they all took their weapons; and they kindled a fire in their camp; and that night they kept watch, and they made a great noise.
And it came to pass on the second day that Holophernes commanded his horses to be saddled before the children of Israel.
And they sought to see the entrance of their cities, and they sought their water source; and there came before them the men of war to reach there and to seek out the inhabitants.
And he went quickly with his army; and all the captains of the children of Esau and all the men of Moab and all the rulers of the sea coast came unto him.
And they said, “O Lord, let not our words be a curse upon your army.”
These are the children of Israel, whose dwellings are in the valleys and in the mountains; they are not fortified by their strength; for they have no exit for their flocks.
አቤቱ አሁንም በሰልፍ ሥርዐት አቷጋቸው፤ ከሠራዊትህ አንድ ሰው ስንኳ የሚሞት አይኑር።
ነገር ግን አንተ ከሠራዊትህ ጋር በሰፈር ጠብቃቸው፤ አሽከሮችህና የሠራዊትህ አርበኞች ሁሉ ከተራራው በታች የሚፈልቅ የውኃቸውን ምንጮች ሁሉ አጽንተው ይጠብቁ።
በቤጤልዋ የሚኖሩ ሰዎች ሁሉ ከዚህ ውኃ ስለሚቀዱ ውኃ ጥም ይገድላቸዋል፤ ሀገራቸውንም ለአንተ ያሰገዛሉ፤ ሠራዊቶቻችንና እኛም ላንባቸው ቅርብ ወደ ሆነ ቦታ ወደ ኮረብታቸውም ራስ እንወጣለን ካንባቸው አንድ ሰው ስንኳ የሚወጣ እንዳይኖር በዚያ ሰፍረን እንጠብቃቸዋለን።
እነርሱ፥ ሚስቶቻቸውና ልጆቻቸውም በረኃብ ይጠፋሉ፤ ሳይዋጓቸውም ባገራቸው ጎዳና ይወድቃሉ።
ከድተዋልና፥ በሰላምም አልተቀበሉህምና ጽኑ በቀልን ትበቀላቸዋለህ።”
በሆሎፎርኒስ ፊትና በሠራዊቱ ሁሉ ፊት ቃላቸው ደስ አሰኘ፤ እንደ ተናገሩም ያደርጉ ዘንድ አዘዘ።
የአሞን ልጆች ሠራዊትም ተጓዙ፤ አምስት ሺህ የሚሆኑ የአሦር ሠራዊትም ከእነርሱ ጋር ነበሩ፤ በአውሎኒም ሰፈሩ፤ የእስራኤልንም ልጆች ምንጮችና ውኃቸውን አስቀድመው ያዙ።

የኤሳውና የአሞን ልጆችም ወጥተው በዶታይም አንጻር ባሉ ተራሮች ሰፈሩ፤ ከእነርሱም በምኩር ወንዝ ባለ በኩሲ አጠገብ ባለ በኤቄሬቢን አንጻር ወደ ደቡብና ወደ ምሥራቅ ሰዎችን ላኩ። የቀሩት የአሦር ሠራዊቶች ግን በምድረ በዳ ሰፈሩ፤ ሀገሩንም ሁሉ አለበሱት፤ ከዚህም በኋላ ጓዛቸውን ከእነርሱ የሚበዛ የሌለ ሠራዊታቸውንና ብዙ ገንዘባቸውን አጓዙ።

sections.title: The Lamentation of Israel.

verses.text: Their enemies, because of their greatness, and because there was no way out among them, their bodies trembled, and the children of Israel cried out to their God, to the Lord.

The Assyrians, along with all their armies, and their cavalry, and those who were stationed on horses and chariots, remained for thirty-four days; and those who dwelt in Bethel were all without water in their vessels.
The land that they thirsted for had no water to quench them; they returned to drinking while they were measuring.
Their children and their wives, their young men were terrified; they were in the depths of water; and in the city, they fell at the gate and in the street; and after this, they had no strength left.
The entire people, the young men and the leaders of the city, the children and the women gathered to Uzziah; and they raised their voices and cried out. And before their leaders, they said:
“Upon us, a great calamity has come; for the Assyrians have come against us in peace, and have not spoken good concerning you and us; may the Lord judge between you and us.”
Even now, let us be delivered; and before them, let us perish in the depths of water and in great destruction, for the Lord has cast us into their hands.
Even now, they have taken us; let them be removed so that from all your cities, for the inhabitants of Holofornis and the army, they may be delivered.

That our bodies may not perish, and that the death of our children may not be seen by our eyes, if we perish in the depths of water, and if we are delivered, it would be better for us; for our wives and our children’s bodies shall not be forsaken.
Behold, today, on this day, do not do this thing; let the heavens and the earth witness against our fathers, for our sins and as our sins judge us, let our fathers’ God, the Lord, not forsake us.”
And among the congregation there was a strong cry; all were united in their lamentation; and they lifted their voices and cried out unto the Lord.

And they said, "Brethren! Let us not despair in our affliction, for our Creator, the Lord, will surely restore His mercy upon us; and let us believe until He returns to us, for indeed, He shall deliver us in five days."
"If after these five days deliverance does not come, we shall do as you have spoken."

And the people went to their respective places; and they went to their city gates and entered; and they sent their wives and children back to their homes; and in the city, they were greatly distressed.

sections.title: The lineage and deeds of Judith.

verses.text: And in those days, there was a son of Israel, the son of Seleshday, the son of Selamyah, the son of Nathaniel, the son of Eliab, the son of Elias, the son of Hakiq, the son of Rawail, the son of Gadeon, the son of Anan, the son of Helqiah, the son of Oziah, the son of Joseph, the son of Hoks, the son of Merari, named Yodit.
And her husband was of the lineage of Manasseh, from the land of Gibeah; and he died in the days when the oppression of the enemy came upon them.

And he went out among those who were harvesting, and he struck himself, and he fell asleep; and he died in his own land, in his own place, just as his fathers had done in their land, in Dothaim and in Belamon, where they were buried.
And Yodit was in the state of mourning for three years and four months, remaining in her house.
And in her house, she prepared a portion for the feast, and she adorned herself with her ornaments; and she dressed her heart in the attire of mourning.

And during the time of her mourning, she fasted continually. On the Sabbath, she did not eat, and on the Sabbath, she did not partake; on the days of her purification, she did not eat, and on the days of her purification; except on the feasts and the days of joy for Israel, she did not eat.

She was exceedingly beautiful and very fair; and in her beauty, she was like the brightness of the sun, and she was adorned with gold and silver, and both women and men were captivated by her, and she possessed much wealth, and her land was fruitful, and she dwelt among them.
For she feared the Lord God, and in her, there was no evil word spoken.

sections.title: Judith and the leaders of Israel.

verses.text: The water has departed, and their bodies have trembled; and the people have heard the evil words spoken by their leaders; and Judith also spoke to the people all the words that Oziah had commanded her, saying that after five days they should deliver their land to the Assyrians.
Send forth all your treasures and your wealth, and call upon Oziah, and upon the men of your city, both the elders and the rulers.

And they came to her; and she said, "Today what you have spoken before the people is not good; for those who dwell in Bethulia, listen! Hear me, O Lord, if in these five days You do not help your people, I shall deliver your land to our enemies, and you shall be put to shame before the Lord and before you."
Now, on this day, you who provoke the Lord, what are you to Him, you who have risen against the Lord and against man?
Yet He, the Lord, will examine you; but you do not know what the Lord does at all times.

How can you examine the Lord, who knows the secret of the heart of man and understands the thoughts of the heart? How can you examine Him? How can you love Him if you do not know your own heart? Brothers, do not be deceived; our God, the Lord, does not grieve you.
If He does not permit us to be helped in these five days, then at any time, when He permits, He will help us; or He has the power to deliver us from our enemies.
For the Lord is not as a man that He should be deceived, nor as a man that He should change; therefore, do not provoke the Lord, our God.
But if you seek Him, you will find mercy; and if you hear our words, He will help us, as He has promised.

"In our time or today, as it was done in former times, whether it be among us or among others, whether it be a city or a dwelling, there is no one to rise up to destroy the idols made by the hands of men."
Therefore, our fathers were strong for battle and for defense; they stood firm before their enemies and did not falter.
But we do not know any other god besides Him; therefore, we trust in Him, that He may not forsake us or our kin.
In the time of our distress, all Judah shall be gathered; our holy ones shall be gathered, and in His sanctuary, the assembly shall be established from our midst.

The slaughter of our brethren, the devastation of our land, and the desolation of our inheritance shall return upon us from the nations that oppress us; for the money they possess shall be a snare unto us, and we shall become prey.
Our possessions shall be without gratitude, for our God, the Lord, has not seen our affliction.
"Now, brethren, speak to our enemies; for they shall bring us down, and their hearts have turned towards us, and their sanctuary and house of worship shall dwell securely among us."
Let us give thanks to our God, the Lord, for all that He has done for our fathers as He has tested them.
As He tested Abraham, as He tested Isaac, and as He tested Jacob, consider how He protected the brother of their mother, Laban, while he watched over his flocks in Syria.

And in their testing, when their hearts were tried, we were not the ones who were found guilty; for it is the Lord who says, "Let those who are brought near be forgiven," and not that He would destroy them.
And Isaiah said, "Speak all that you have spoken with a good heart; for your word shall not be condemned."
Your wisdom has not begun today, for from the beginning of your time, every man has known your wisdom; indeed, it is the very nature of your heart.
However, the people have become weary and have grown faint; therefore, let us act as they say, and let us bring forth that which we cannot change.
Even now, you are a woman who fears the Lord, and the Lord will grant us favor; may our cry be heard, that henceforth we may not be forsaken.
And Judith said, "Hear me, for I will perform the work that is spoken of for the son of man."
But you, stand by the door this night; I too will go out with my maid; we shall deliver our land into the hands of our enemies, and in that hour, the God of Israel shall aid me.
But you shall not question the work I do; for I will not speak to you until my work is accomplished.
And Ozias and his leaders said, "Go in peace; and may the Lord be before you; may He also scatter our enemies."
And they returned and went to their husbands.

sections.title: The Prayer of Judith

verses.text: ዮዲት ግን በግንባሯ ተደፍታ በምድር ላይ ወደቀች፤ በራሷም ላይ ትቢያ ነሰነሰች፤ የምትለብሰውንም ማቅ አሳየች፤ በኢየሩሳሌምም ባለው በእግዚአብሔር ቤተ መቅደስ የሠርክ ዕጣን በሚቀርብበት ጊዜ ዮዲት በታላቅ ቃል ወደ እግዚአብሔር ጮኸች፤ እንዲህም አለች፦
“በማኅፀን ያለ ጽንስን ያጠፉ፥ ድንግልንም ያጐሰቈሉ፥ ልብሷንም የገፈፉ፥ በከተማም በአራቱ ማዕዘን ለመገዳደር ማኅፀንን ያሳደፉ ጠላቶችን ይበቀል ዘንድ በእጁ ሰይፍን የሰጠኸው የአባቴ የስምዖን አምላክ ሆይ፥ አንተ እንዲህ አይደለም አልህ፤ እነርሱ ግን አደረጉት።
ስለዚህም አለቆቻቸውን ለመገደል አሳልፈህ ሰጠሃቸው፤ መኝታቸውም በተገደሉት ባሮች ደም ተነከረ፤ ባሮችን ከጌቶቻቸው ጋር፥ ጌቶችንም በዙፋኖቻቸው ላይ ገደልሃቸው።
ሚስቶቻቸውና ልጆቻቸው ተማረኩ፤ በአንተ ዘንድ የተወደዱ፥ ለአምላክነትህም የቀኑ፥ የረከሰ ደማቸውንም የተጸየፉ፥ ትረዳቸውም ዘንድ የለመኑ የልጆችን ምርኮ ሁሉ ተካፈሉ፤ አምላኬ እግዚአብሔር ሆይ፥ እኔን መበለቲቱን ስማኝ።
ከዚህ አስቀድሞና ከዚያም በኋላ የሆነውን አንተ አድርገሃልና የዛሬውንና የሚመጣውንም ታውቀዋለህ፤ አንተም በምታውቀው ሆነ።
ምክርህ የቀና ነው፤ ሥርዐትህ የተዘጋጀ ነውና፥ ፍርድህንም አስቀድመህ ባወቅህ ፈርደሃልና እነሆ፥ መጣን ይሉሃል፤

“እነሆ፥ የአሦር ሰዎች ከሠራዊታቸው ጋር በዝተዋልና፥ በፈረሶቻቸውም ላይ ከፍ ከፍ ብለዋልና፥ በፈረስም የተቀመጡ ሰዎች በኀይላቸው ታምነዋልና፥ አርበኞችም በጽናታቸው፥ በቀስታቸውና በጦራቸው፥ በምድር ነጎዳቸውም ታምነዋልና አንተ አርበኞችን የምታጠፋ አምላክ እንደ ሆንህ አላወቁህምና ስምህም አሸናፊ እንደ ሆነ አልተገነዘቡም።
አንተ ከሠራዊታቸው ጋር በከሃሊነትህ አጥፋቸው፤ ቤተ መቅደስን ያጐሰቍሉ ዘንድ፥ የስምህ ጌትነት ማደሪያ የሆነች ደብተራ ኦሪትንም ያሳድፉ ዘንድ መክረዋልና፥ በብረትም የመሠዊያህን ቀንዶች አፍርሰዋልና በቍጣህ ኀይላቸውን አጥፋ።
ትዕቢታቸውን ተመልከት፤ በራሳቸውም ላይ ቍጣህን አምጣ። እንደ አሰብሁት እፈጽም ዘንድ በእኔ በመበለቲቱ እጅ ኀይልን አድርግ።
በአንደበቴ ጥበብ ሎሌውን ከጌታው፥ ጌታውንም ከሎሌው ጋር ግደል። ግርማቸውን በእኔ በሴቲቱ እጅ አጥፋ።

Thy strength is not in many, nor is Thy power in mighty men; but Thou art the God of the humble, the helper of the weak, the healer of the sick, the protector of the lost, and the restorer of hope to those who have lost it.
O Lord, my God, the God of my father, the God of Israel, the God of heaven and earth, who created the waters, and the King of all creation, hear my prayer.
Let the wisdom of Thy word, by Thy law and by Thy sanctuary, upon Mount Zion and upon the house of Thy children, cause the enemies who seek to do evil to be confounded and to be destroyed.
Thou art the God of all strength and power, O Lord God; there is none other that can deliver Thy people but Thee, that all the nations and tribes may know it.

sections.title: And Judith prepared herself to go unto Holofernes.

verses.text: ከዚህም በኋላ ወደ እስራኤል አምላክ መለመኗን ከጨረሰችና ይህንም ነገር ሁሉ ከፈጸመች በኋላ፥
ከወደቀችበት ቦታ ተነሣች፤ ብላቴናዋንም ጠርታ በሰንበታትና በበዓላት ቀኖች ወደምትቀመጥበት ቤትዋ ወረደች።
የለበሰችውንም ማቅ አወለቀች፤ የመበለትነትዋንም ልብስ ለበሰች፥ ሰውነትዋንም በውኃ ታጠበች፤ ጠጕርዋንም ያማረ ሽቱ ተቀባች፤ ጠጕርዋንም ተሠራች፤ አጌጠችም፤ ከዚህም በኋላ ባሏ ምናሴ በሕይወት በነበረ ጊዜ የምትለብሰውን የደስታ ልብሷን ለበሰች።
ጫማዋንም ተጫማች፤ አልቦዋንና ቀለበትዋን፥ አምባርዋንና ጉትቻዋንም አደረገች፤ ጌጡንም ሁሉ አጌጠች፤ የሚያዩአትንም ወንዶች ሁሉ ዐይን እስክታስት ድረስ ፈጽማ አጌጠች።
የወይኑን ገንቦና የዘይቱን ማሰሮ ትሸከም ዘንድ ለብላቴናዋ ሰጠቻት፤ ስልቅ በሶውን፥ የስንዴ አምባሻውንና በለሱን በስልቻዋ መላች፤ ገንዘብዋንም ሁሉ አንግታ አሸከመቻት።
ወደ ቤጤልዋ ከተማ በርም ሄደች፤ ዖዝያንን፥ ያገር ሽማግሌዎችን ከርሚንና ከብሪምንም በዚያ ቆመው አገኘቻቸው።
ፊትዋ ተለውጦ፥ በሚያስደንቅ ሁኔታ ልብሷን ለብሳ ባዩአት ጊዜ ከደም ግባቷ ማማር የተነሣ እጅግ ተደነቁ፤ እንዲህም አሏት፦
“ለኢየሩሳሌም ልዕልናና ለእስራኤል ልጆች ክብር በልብሽ ያሰብሽውን ታደርጊ ዘንድ የአባቶቻችን አምላክ ሞገስን ይስጥሽ።” እርሷም ለእግዚአብሔር ሰገደች።
እንዲህም አለቻቸው፥ “አሁንም ከእናንተ ጋራ የተናገርሁትንነገር ወጥቼ አደርግ ዘንድ የከተማውን በር የሚከፍትልኝ ሰው እዘዙልኝ፤” እንደ ጠየቀችም ይከፍቱላት ዘንድ ጐልማሶችን አዘዙአቸው።
ይህንም በአደረጉ ጊዜ ዮዲት ወጣች፤ ብላቴናዋም ከእርሷ ጋር ወጣች፤ የከተማው ሰዎችም ካንባው ወርዳ ከሸለቆው እስክታልፍ ድረስ ያዩአት ነበር፤ ከዚህ በኋላ ግን አላዩአትም።
በቀጥታም በሸለቆው ሄደች፤ የአሦራውያንም ዘበኞች አገኙአት።
ይዘውም መረመሩአት፤ እንዲህም አሏት፥ “አንቺ ማን ነሽ? ከየት መጣሽ? ወዴትስ ትሄጃለሽ?” እርስዋም አለቻቸው፥ “እኔ ከዕብራውያን የተወለድሁ ነኝ፤ ሀገራቸውን ለእናንተ አሳልፈው ሊሰጡ በወደዱ ጊዜ ከእነርሱ ኰብልዬ መጣሁ።
እኔ እውነተኛ ነገርን እነግረው ዘንድ፥ የምትሄዱበትንም ጎዳና አሳየው ዘንድ ወደ ቢትወደዳችሁ ወደ ሆሎፎርኒስ አስቀድሜ መጣሁ፤ አውራጃቸውንም ሁሉ ገንዘብ ታደርጋላችሁ፤ ከሰዎቻችሁ አንድ ሰው ስንኳ የሚቈስል የለም።”
እነዚያም ሰዎች ቃልዋን በሰሙ ጊዜ፥ ፊትዋንም ባዩ ጊዜ፥ ደም ግባትዋም ፈጽሞ የተደነቀ እንደ ሆነ ባዩ ጊዜ እንዲህ አሏት፦
“ወደ ጌታችን ፈጥነሽ የወረድሽ አንቺ ሕይወትሽን አዳንሽ። አሁንም ወደ ድንኳኑ ሂጂ፤ ወደ እርሱ የሚያደርስሽን ሰው ከእኛ እንልካለን።
በፊቱም በቆምሽ ጊዜ ይህን ነገርሽን ንገሪው እንጂ ልቡናሽ አይፍራ፤ በጎ ነገርን ያደርግልሻል።”
ከእርስዋና ከብላቴናዋ ጋር የሚሄዱ አንድ መቶ ሰዎችን መረጡ፤ ወደ ሆሎፎርኒስ ድንኳንም አደረሷት።
ሕዝቡም ሁሉ ተሰበሰቡ፤ በድንኳኑ ፊት እንዳለች ዜናዋ በሰፈሩ ተሰምቶ ነበርና መጥተው ስለ እርሷ እስኪነግሩት ድረስ ከሆሎፎርኒስ ድንኳን ውጭ ከብበዋት ቆሙ።
ደም ግባትዋንም አደነቁ፤ ስለ እርስዋም የእስራኤልን ልጆች አደነቁ፤ እርስ በርሳቸውም፥ “እንደ እነዚህ ያሉ ሴቶች ያሉትን ሕዝብ የሚንቅ ማን ነው? ዓለሙን ሁሉ ሊተነኰሉ ስለሚችሉ ከእነዚህ ሰዎች አንድ ሰውስ እንኳ ይቀር ዘንድ መልካም አይደለም” ተባባሉ።
በሆሎፎርኒስ አጠገብ የተቀመጡ አሽከሮቹም ሁሉ መጥተው ወደ ድንኳኑ አገቧት።
And the golden chalice, adorned with precious stones and of great value, was made of pure white linen, and it was placed upon the altar within the sanctuary, where it rested.
And they spoke of her matters; and she went forth to the entrance; and before her, the silver veil did shine.

And when Judith drew near unto him, the guards stood still; and all were troubled, for the blood of the slain had risen upon them; and she fell upon the earth before him, and the guards were astonished.

sections.title: Judith's first encounter with Holofernes.

verses.text: "O Holophernes, I am a woman of faith; for the Lord of all the earth, our God, shall deliver you into my hands, and I shall not do any evil thing against you; therefore let not your heart be troubled."

"Even now, among those who dwell in the mountains, these your kindred, though they have not been harmed, I have not raised my sword against them; yet indeed, they have done this thing unto themselves."
"Now tell me, why have you come to us from among them? But I pray that you may find life, and that you may dwell with us forever this night."
"As we do for our lord, our master, Nebuchadnezzar, so shall we do for you; and there is no evil thing that you shall do unto you."
"And Judith said, 'Receive my word, for I, your servant, shall speak before you; this night I shall not speak a falsehood before my lord.'"
"If you heed my servant's word, the Lord shall perform a perfect work for you; for there is nothing that shall fall from you, my lord, that is not worthy."

"Let Nebuchadnezzar, king of all the earth, live! May all creation be subject to you, and may the power that you have sent forth endure. The beasts that dwell in the wilderness and the birds that fly in the heavens shall dwell under your might, but it is not only for the men of your time that they shall be subject."
"We have heard of your work and your wisdom, and in all the kingdom you alone are esteemed; in all your works you are strong, and in all your endeavors you are exalted."
"Even now, we have heard your words in your assembly; for the people of your house have spoken all that you have said."
"O my lord, do not dismiss my words; for the truth is in your heart; if they have not offended their Creator, our people cannot perish; nor can the sword destroy them."
Now, my Lord, may their deaths come upon them, that they may not be found wanting before Thee, for their sins have caused them to be grieved by their wicked deeds.
Their sustenance and water have not ceased, and they have returned to consume their livestock; may their God not allow them to eat that which is forbidden to them, for they have come to this end.

The first of their sustenance and the ten of their wine, which are set apart for our Creator, are not to be given to the priests who dwell in Jerusalem, for they have thought to consume this oil which is not fitting for them.
They were sent with the permission of the rulers to Jerusalem; for those who dwell there have acted thus.
After they spoke of their permission and did thus, the Lord shall turn His face away from them at that time.
"I am Your servant; I have been with them all this time; the one who hears the voice and all the earth that trembles, I shall work this deed with You, for the Lord has sent me."

I am Your servant, for I fear the Lord God, and I serve Him day and night. O Lord, now I dwell with You; however, I am Your servant, and I shall go forth to the wilderness to pray to the Lord; may He reveal to me their sins which they have committed.
I have come to speak this to you; you shall go forth with all your hosts; there shall be none to oppose you.

Until you arrive in Jerusalem, I shall keep you in Judah; in the midst of it, your canopy shall be spread, and I shall protect them as you have commanded; the dogs shall not bark before you. Thus have I been told; I have sent this message to you.
And they rejoiced greatly at the news of Holofornis and all the people. They also praised their wisdom.
And it was said, “From the edge of the earth to the edge of the earth, before her, there is no woman who possesses wisdom as this one, whose blood is poured forth.”
And Holophernes said, “Strength is in your hand; let destruction come upon my lord, as you have sent forth before your people, for the Lord God has done good unto you.”

Now you are beautiful in your appearance; and by your words, you are blessed; as you have done, your God shall be my God; and you shall dwell in the king’s palace, and your name shall be renowned throughout all the land.”

sections.title: Judith was betrothed to Holofernes.

verses.text: And he commanded that the vessel of silver be placed where it may rest; and that he be brought food from those who prepare for him, and that he be given drink from that which he may drink.
And Judith said, "I shall eat of that which I have brought, lest it be a sin against him, for I will not eat of his food."
And Holophernes answered, "If what you bring should be insufficient for you, from whence shall we provide for you? There is no man among your kin who is with you."
And Judith said, "As the Lord my God liveth, until he accomplish that which he hath spoken by me, I shall serve thee, lest I perish, O my lord, thy living soul."
And the servants of Holophernes came unto the tent; and they rested until the middle of the night. And at midnight, they arose before the dawn of the day.
"Permit me, that I may go forth to pray," she said, and she sent to Holophernes.

And Holophernes commanded those who were to guard her, saying, "Let her not be hindered." And after this, she remained in the camp three days; and each night she went forth to the valley of Bethulia, and she would bathe in the spring that was in the camp; and at night she would go down to the spring to wash.
And when she went forth from the water, she prayed concerning her people and her children, that she might find a way to go before the God of Israel and to pray unto the Lord.
And after this, she would return; and she would dwell in the camp in purity; and by night she would eat.
And after this, on the fourth day, Holophernes made a feast for his servants alone; and no other man was called to the feast.
All the wealth of the treasury was in the hands of the steward, and he said, "This Hebrew woman who is with you is coming to us; let her eat and drink with us; and you go and speak to her."
"For we have found a woman like this, and she is our help," he said. "And when we speak to her, she will be with us."

And he went to her from the steward, saying, "O beautiful one, my daughter! Do not refuse to come to my lord; for you will be honored by him; and with him, you will drink wine, and it will please you; for you will be like one of the daughters of Assyria who serve in the house of the king."
And Judith said, "If I do not go to my lord, who am I? And who is my family? I will do all that you desire before you; and even unto death, it shall be joy for me."

And she arose and adorned herself; she put on all the ornaments of women; and she went with her maid; and she took what she had received from the steward, and she adorned herself in front of Holophernes upon the earth.
And Judith came to him and sat down; and Holophernes' heart was captivated by her; and his body was consumed with desire for her; and he kept her until he could be with her.
And Holophernes said to Judith, "Drink, and be glad with us."
And Judith said, "From the day of my birth until now, my life has been more precious than today, and I will drink with my lord."
And her maid prepared for her, and she received it and ate before him; and she drank.
And Holophernes was glad for her; for from the day of her birth, there was no day that she had not drunk much wine.

sections.title: Judith struck down Holofernes as one who had been cut off.

verses.text: And in the time of the siege, the assailants hastened and drove away the men; and they also caused their tents to be removed from outside the wall. And before the Lord, they drove away the assailants who stood, and they all entered into their dwelling, for they were weary from thirst.
And Judith remained alone in the tent with Holophernes; but he was overcome with wine and lay upon his bed in a deep sleep.

And Judith commanded her maid to go forth and stand at the entrance of her dwelling, saying, “I will go out to pray.” And she instructed her to wait for her until she should return, as a watchman waits for the coming of the dawn; and she spoke likewise to Holophernes.

And all went forth from her; and whether small or great, none remained beside her. And Judith arose and stood by her bed. And she said in her heart, “O Lord God of all power, behold this thing; for Jerusalem is exalted and lifted up, and at this hour grant me strength in my hand.”
“For the time has come for her to be delivered, and let all our enemies perish,” she said.
And she went to Holophernes' bed and took his own sword.
And she stood by his head, and she grasped his own sword, saying, “O Lord God of Israel, today strengthen me.”
And she struck his neck twice with all her might; and she severed his head.

And she cast his head down to the ground from the bed; and she took away the canopy of his bed; and she gave it to her maid, and they went forth, and she delivered the head of Holophernes to her maid.

sections.title: And Judith returned unto her home.

verses.text: And she, having been in the place of prayer, gathered together with her companions; and they both went forth in unity, and did not depart from the place where they had gathered, but turned towards the river; and they went to her house and arrived at the city gate.

And Judith spoke to the guards at the gate, saying, "Today, let us strengthen ourselves as we have done before, for the Lord is with us against our enemies; therefore, open the gate; open it," she commanded them.
And after this, when the people of the city heard her words, they hastened to the city gate; and they called out to the elders of the city.
And as she returned, they received her with joy, and all the great ones ran forth; and they lifted her up at the gate; and a fire was kindled, and they rejoiced together.
"Let us destroy our enemies this night by my hand, and let not mercy and forgiveness be far from Israel, for I will glorify the Lord with a great voice; let us glorify Him," she commanded them.

And she showed them the head of the Assyrian general, Holofernes, saying, "Behold, this is the head of Holofernes, the commander of the Assyrian army; when he was drinking, he fell asleep, and the Lord delivered him into my hand."
"To die by my hand is not a shame, for I have walked in the path of righteousness; and as for my sins and my iniquities, the Lord is alive, for He has not forsaken me," she declared.
And all the people rejoiced and praised the Lord; and they said with one voice, "Today, on this day, You have delivered our enemies; You are our God, blessed are You."

And Ozias said, "Among the women of this world, you are blessed, my daughter, for the Lord has favored you. He who created heaven and earth, and has delivered us from our enemies, blessed be the Lord."
For the power of the Lord endures forever, and Your praise shall not be forgotten in the hearts of men.

O Lord, may You grant this unto her for eternity, that she may be honored; for concerning her kindred, she said, "Let me perish," but before our Creator, the Lord, she walked directly, and for her flesh, she did not turn aside, but may He regard her with His mercy. And all the people said, "Amen, Amen."

sections.title: The counsel of Judith.

verses.text: And Judith said, "Brothers, listen to me; take this sword and strike him at the nape of his neck."

After this, when the sun rises, all of you shall take your weapons; let all the men who are warriors depart from the city; and as you descend to the place where the Assyrian army is, let your leader be for yourselves. However, do not depart.

All of you shall take your weapons, and when you see the Assyrian soldiers, let them strike down their leaders, and they shall flee to their encampment; thereafter, they shall run to the sanctuary of Holophernes; they shall not find him; and after that, they shall flee exceedingly from before you.
After this, you and all the people who dwell in the region of Israel shall follow them; and in all your streets, let them run.
"And before you do this, let him know that he who has sent him to us is indeed of the lineage of Israel, so that he may understand that he is our enemy," they said to him.
And they called for Achior from the house of Ozias; and when he came, and saw the head of Holophernes in a man's hand, his body trembled and fell among the people in the midst of the assembly.
And at that moment, Judith fell upon her feet; and she said to them, "You are blessed among all women of Judah and among all people; and your name shall be remembered with joy."
"Now tell me of the deeds you have done," she said. And Judith spoke to the people all that she had done from the time she went out until she returned.
And when she spoke, the whole people listened to her words and rejoiced; and in every city, they shouted with joy.
And Achior, the Lord had done wonders for Israel, and at that time, he was greatly honored in the sight of the Lord. Even until this day, he has remained one with the house of Israel.

sections.title: The death of Holophernes was made manifest.

verses.text: And in the evening, they hung the head of Holofernes upon the wall; and all the men took their weapons and went forth, and they encamped upon the mountain on their side.
And the Assyrian army, at that time, sent to their captains; and they went to their leaders, to their captains and their rulers.
And they came to Holofernes' tent to the steward, saying, "These men will remain until the end, for they have been scattered and have fallen away, and they have disturbed our lord from his sleep."
And it is said that she lay with Yodith, and having entered the tent, she struck him with the sword that was in her hand.
And a man who would answer him, at that moment, rushed into the tent and entered into the inner chamber; and he fell upon his face upon the ground. And he was not upon the upper part.
While he was trembling and shaking, he cried out with a loud voice; and he tore his garment.
And Yodith entered the tent where she was to be, but she did not find him; and she went out to the people, running and crying out to them. And she said to them:

"These men will not prevail; behold, the head of Holofernes is fallen upon the earth, and he is not upon the upper part, for a certain Hebrew woman has wrought great destruction upon him in the house of our lord."
And when the captains of the Assyrian army heard this, they tore their garments; and their bodies were greatly troubled; and with a loud voice, they cried out in the midst of the camp.

sections.title: The Assyrians fled in haste.

verses.text: And the people who were in the camp rejoiced greatly concerning the matter that had come to pass;
Fear and trembling seized them; for there was not a man who stood with his neighbor. But behold, they all fled together in unity unto the wilderness and unto the mountainous land.

And those who dwelt round about Bethel, and in the camp and in the mountainous land, all the people gathered and fled; and at that time, all the sons of Israel who were valiant arose and followed them.

And concerning all that had happened, they spoke, and all helped one another, and they pursued their enemies, and they sent unto Bethel and unto Bime, and unto Kobi and unto Kola, and unto all the regions of Israel.

And the children of Israel, when they heard, all together followed until they reached Kobi; for they had declared unto them the matter that was in the camp concerning their enemies, and those who came from Jerusalem and from all its regions followed them likewise; and the people who came from Galilee and from Gilead joined them; and from Damascus and from all its regions until they had gathered a great multitude and followed them.
And those who dwelt in Bethel went down to the Assyrian camp and plundered their riches; they completed their task and returned.

And after this, the children of Israel returned from whence they had fled; for from many days past, they had been in a wide region, and they took with them the dwellings and cities that remained in the mountainous land and in the plain.

sections.title: Honor the feast of the Israelites.

verses.text: The great priest Jehoiakim and the children of Israel who dwell in Jerusalem, the elders, came to see the good thing that the Lord had done for Israel, and they came to greet Judith with peace.
And when they entered unto her, they all spoke as one, saying, "Thou art the glory of Jerusalem; thou art the honor of Israel; thou art the guide of our people."

"All this hath been done by thy hand, and thou hast wrought this good thing for Israel; and the Lord hath loved them, and the Lord God, who possesseth all, may He bless thee forever!" And all the people said, "Amen."

And the people dwelt there for thirty days; and they gave unto Judith all the spoils of Holophernes and all the vessels of silver, and the canopy, and all the money that was there; and she took them and laid them upon her ass; and her maidens went with her bearing them.
And all the women of Israel came to see her, and they gathered unto her, and they made a great feast for her; and they placed the crown upon her head; and she gave to the women that were with her.

And she and her maidens made a dance of joy and of the timbrel before the people; and she went forth singing, leading all the women; and all the warriors of Israel followed her, bearing their weapons and singing praises.

sections.title: The Psalm of Praise of Judith

verses.text: And Judith began to sing this song of praise throughout all Israel; and all the people continued to sing this song of praise after her.
And Judith said, “Let us glorify my God with a hymn;
for the Lord shall defeat the enemy in battle.”
His name is the Lord;
let the Assyrians flee from the mountain.
Let them burn our region with fire;
yet the Lord shall destroy them all by the hand of a woman.
Their warriors shall not rise against her,
for she shall be clothed in the garments of her mourning, as she speaks to the people of Israel.
And her face was radiant.
Their shoes were upon their eyes;
From the place of their falling, the men of Paris rejoiced;
At that time, the afflicted tribes rejoiced greatly;
The daughters of women and their children were gathered together;
I will sing a psalm unto the Lord;
O Lord, Thou art still;
All Thy creation is subject unto Thee;
The mountains shall tremble with their foundations;
All offerings are not fitting for a good cause;
Woe unto the nations that rise against their brethren in enmity;
በሥጋቸውም እሳትና ትልን ይልክባቸዋል፤
ወደ ኢየሩሳሌምም በደረሱ ጊዜ ለእግዚአብሔር ሰገዱ፤ ሕዝቡም ራሳቸውን ባነጹ ጊዜ የሚቃጠለውን መሥዋዕታቸውንና የፈቃድ ቍርባናቸውን፥ ስጦታቸውንም አቀረቡ።
ዮዲትም ሕዝቡ የሰጧትን የሆሎፎርኒስን ገንዘብ፥ ከመኝታ ቤቱም የወሰደችውን የራስጌውን ሰይፍ ለመታሰቢያ ለእግዚአብሔር ሰጠች።
ሕዝቡም በኢየሩሳሌም በቤተ መቅደስ ፊት ሦስት ወር ደስታ አደረጉ፤ ዮዲትም ከእነርሱ ጋር ተቀመጠች።
ከእነዚያም ወራት በኋላ ሰው ሁሉ ወደ ርስቱ ተመለሰ፤ ዮዲትም ወደ ቤጤልዋ ተመልሳ በንብረቷ ኖረች፤ በዘመኗም በሀገሩ ሁሉ የከበረች ሆነች።
የሚፈልጓትም ብዙዎች ነበሩ፤ ባሏ ምናሴ ሞቶ በወገኖቹ ዘንድ ከተቀበረ ጀምሮ በሕይወት ዘመኗ ሁሉ በግብር ያወቃት ሰው የለም።
ፈጽማም በክብር ገነነች።
በባሏ በምናሴም ቤት እስክታረጅ ድረስ ኖረች፤ ዕድሜዋም መቶ ዐምስት ዐመት ነበር፤ ያችንም ብላቴናዋን ነጻ አወጣቻት፤ በቤጤልዋ ሞታ በባሏ በምናሴ ዋሻ ተቀበረች፤
የእስራኤልም ወገኖች ሰባት ቀን አለቀሱላት፤ ከመሞትዋም በፊት ገንዘብዋን ለባልዋ ለምናሴ አቅራቢያና ለእርሷ አቅራቢያ ለሆኑ ዘመዶችዋ አካፈለች።
የእስራኤልንም ልጆች በዮዲት ዘመን፥ ዳግመኛም እርስዋ ከሞተች በኋላ ለብዙ ዘመን ያስፈራቸው አልነበረም።
